earlierBatches.reason: Source port differed from applied port; malformed YAML fixture was accepted as empty payload.
Phone could not route to the Mac private HTTP endpoint; no route to host independently confirmed.
Domain-form SOCKS request fell through to Match in the first ipcidr scenario.
Strict nullable destination-IP observer timed out.
HTTP 8 and first File domain variants hit, but File ipcidr fell through to Match under original sniffing.
19 combinations passed; public success-control and original MRS downloads failed. Final fixture isolates control HTTP and logs bounded MRS retries.

limitations: 750 JVM XML results are clean; final build reused up-to-date tasks. No forced-rerun claim. Go not rerun.
New network cases are pure proxy/SOCKS on Redmi API36 arm64 portrait/default font. No new VPN, low API, cellular, signed Release runtime, CI or publication verification.

Rule matrix is 8 HTTP + 8 File + 3 Inline combinations for public Baidu/domain, China ipcidr and Baidu classical datasets. One original geolocation-cn MRS is separately hit. Not traffic coverage of all original 90 MRS datasets or every site.

Original source is a full unchanged 1.yaml copy; formal bound script deliberately replaces rule definitions/rules and disables sniffing. This proves Provider behavior in an isolated runtime projection, not the full original subscription routing/sniffer interaction.
Source-port + destination443 correlation is not a complete five-tuple check. Byte counters may include TLS handshake; HTTP200/body are independently verified on the same socket.

HTTP caches are seeded from frozen public originals before explicit updates. Byte SHA, positive count and advanced timestamps prove the update contract; this is not empty-cache first download coverage or independent server request counting.
Partial-failure control and two faults use the on-device HTTP server. Public download availability is independently proven by the eight-source matrix, not by that local server.
Original MRS first update failed and second succeeded in the final batch; both attempts are preserved. Earlier failed batches remain separate and are not added to final4/4.

Inline Proxy only expands the first two original nodes in the real core group; their protocol business traffic is not tested. HTTP/File Proxy historical evidence is not rerun as new protocol coverage.
Managed-resource mixed sync/apply failures were statically reviewed but have no new independent branch-specific unit/device fault injection.
Screenshots show recovery states, with some lower rows outside viewport. No complete Flutter visual parity claim. Glass remains off by default; deferred and cancelled scope unchanged.
Raw logs, inputs, XML, APKs and PNGs are persistent local attachments outside Git. Paths/hashes are auditable on this host; remote Git alone does not contain these attachments.
